title: Quality of life and neurocognitive functioning in diffuse low-grade glioma patients treated with Temozolomide: feasibility study - TEMOIN
official: Quality of life and neurocognitive functioning in diffuse low-grade glioma patients treated with Temozolomide: feasibility study - TEMOIN
summary: Main objective: This study will evaluate the feasability in terms of participation and compliance of a complete neurocognitive, psychopathological and QoL assessment (baseline, 6 months and 12 months) in DLGG patients receiving TMZ as a first line treatment after surgery. The data collected in this feasability study will be used to formulate hypotheses for a future multicentric clinical study.
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Adult patient aged ≥ 18, no age limit
2. Negative pregnancy test in women of childbearing potential
3. Signature du consentement éclairé avant toute procédure de l’étude
4. Patient fluent in French
5. Patient affiliated to a French social security system
6. Histologically-proven DLGG
7. Patient receiving TMZ as a first line treatment after surgery, whatever the delay between the surgery and the introduction of TMZ
8. No previous oncologic treatment (except for surgery) for the DLGG;
9. Performance Status score ≤2
10. Absolute neutrophil count (ANC) ≥ 1500 cells/µL and platelet count ≥ 100 000 cells/µL
11. Total serum bilirubin concentration ≤ 1.5 x the upper limit of normal (UPN)
12. Aspartate aminotransferase (AST), alanine aminotransferase (ALT) and alkaline phosphatase ≤ 2.5 x the ULN ;
13. Serum creatine concentration ≤ 1.5 x the ULN
Exclusion criteria:
1. Anaplastic glioma (WHO grade III glioma)
2. Legal incapacity or physical, psychological social or geographical status interfering with the patient's ability to sign the informed consent or to terminate the study
3. Pregnant or breastfeeding women;
4. Men or women of childbearing potential who are unwilling to employ adequate contraception, from the beginning of the study until 6 months after administration of the last treatment dose;
5. Participation in another clinical trial within 30 days prior to study entry.
6. Impaired neurocognitive functioning defined by a score < 22 at the MoCA test
7. Visual or auditory deficit
8. Previous chemotherapy for the DLGG
9. Previous RT for the DLGG
10. Known hypersensitivity to any of the study drugs, or excipients in the formulation
11. Hypersensitivity to dacarbazine (DTIC);
12. Myélosuppression sévère;
13. Problems of galactose intolerance, Lapp lactase deficiency or glucose-galactose malabsorption;
